factual_fidelity.evidence: 'maison mitoyenne' matches semi-detached input; 195 m², 4 chambres, 2 salles de bains all correct; minor stretch 'répartie sur plusieurs niveaux' not explicitly supported but reasonable.

completeness.evidence: Mentions 195 m², 4 chambres, 2 salles de bains, Bertrange context via residential 1990s, plus all active features (parking, garden, terrasse, cave) and photo selling points (south-facing, fireplace, breakfast nook).

native_quality.evidence: Reads natively: 'créant une fluidité entre les espaces de vie et l'extérieur' — natural French syntax, though some phrasing ('intégrant des éléments fonctionnels tels que le parking privatif') is slightly mechanical.

market_fit.evidence: Uses standard LU/FR luxury vocabulary: 'surface habitable', 'séjour ouvert sur la salle à manger', 'cave', 'prestations' align with athome.lu corpus.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE class invented and none in inputs; prose omits energy class entirely, consistent with v1.5 default.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 'Maison mitoyenne quatre chambres avec jardin orienté sud et parking privé' = 12 words but lacks neighborhood (Bertrange). 5 CamelCase hashtags, no duplicates.

tone_discipline.evidence: No hyperbole or exclamation marks; restrained adjectives like 'soigné', 'calme et verdoyant'.

fair_housing.evidence: No reference to occupant demographics; 'adapté à une habitation de ce type' is neutral.

hallucination.evidence: Unsupported: 1 — 'répartie sur plusieurs niveaux' (multi-level not in inputs). Brick facade, 1990s, fireplace, south-facing, breakfast nook, 195 m², 4 bed/2 bath, parking, cellar, garden all supported.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: Numeric agreement (195 m², 4 bed, 2 bath) holds across FR/EN/DE. However listing-kind/property-type disagreement: FR 'maison mitoyenne' and EN 'semi-detached house' agree with input, but DE 'freistehende Einfamilienhaus' asserts freestanding — a feature-list/type disagreement on the same property.
